description: This file contains a unit test class 'LocationTest' for testing the 'Location' entity within the OrangeHRM admin module. The test verifies the correct creation, persistence, and retrieval of a Location entity linked to a Country entity, including checking various attributes and their values.

classes.name: LocationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Location entity in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating specific tables (Country and Location) before each test.

methods.name: testLocationEntity
methods.description: Creates and persists a Country and a Location entity, then retrieves and asserts their attributes to verify correct behavior.
